name: toolsmith-history-add
intent: Add one new entry file to the project's docs/log history.
use_when: You finished a unit of work and the project's docs/LOG.md says to log it before committing.
You would otherwise build the docs/log/<YYYY>/<MM>/<DD>/<epoch>-<slug>.md path with date, mkdir and a heredoc.
not_for: Reading or searching the log: use find, cat or grep on docs/log.
Changing an existing entry: entries are immutable.
Inbox proposals or curated notes: write those as docs/MEMORY.md describes, when the project has one.
Migrating a legacy docs/history or docs/HISTORY.md log: the project-log skill does that.
input: The title as the first argument: a short headline for the entry, made into the file's slug (lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, at most 60 characters). The entry text on stdin: standalone markdown, written exactly as given, with a final newline added when missing. Empty text is refused.

options.text: Write the file but do not run `git add` on it.

output: Stdout is the new file's path, relative to the current directory. The file goes in the docs/log of the nearest directory at or above the current one, up to the git repository root, that has docs/LOG.md or docs/log. Its name is docs/log/<YYYY>/<MM>/<DD>/<unix-time>-<slug>.md, with the UTC date of that time. An existing file is never overwritten. Inside a git repository the file is staged with `git add`, so it lands in the next commit with the work it describes.

exit_codes.text: The entry was written (and staged, inside a git repository).
No entry, or an unstaged one: no project memory found, a legacy docs/history log not yet migrated, the file exists, or a write or `git add` failed.
Nothing written: the title, the text or the arguments are wrong.

examples.title: Add an entry at the repository root
examples.stdin: - Crawled staging: 557 URLs, 3 broken internal links fixed.

files_after.docs/log/*/*/*/*-seo-review-of-staging.m: - Crawled staging: 557 URLs, 3 broken internal links fixed.

examples.title: From deep inside an app that has its own docs/log
A project that still has the legacy docs/history log
examples.stderr: toolsmith-history-add: . still has the legacy docs/history log; migrate it to docs/log with the project-log skill first

examples.title: A project without a work log
examples.stderr: toolsmith-history-add: no docs/LOG.md or docs/log above here; set up the project log with the project-log skill first

examples.title: Empty entry text is refused
examples.stderr:
toolsmith-history-add: the entry text on stdin is empty
Run `toolsmith-history-add --help` for usage, or `toolsmith-history-add --llm` for the full guide.
